{{Top|leg}}
A '''transcar tubeway''' was a form of public transport. They were used on the [[city platform]]s that [[Lant Mining Corporation]] established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lish V]] due to the limited space on the facility. They linked the major buildings of the platform together.
